title: Adjectives describing animals
source: User-provided workbook photo, manually transcribed; Word File German translations suggested separately

entries.description: Full of toxins, like some colourful frogs
Able to kill: a ___ bite
Likely to hurt you; not safe
Ready to attack and fight
Graceful and stylish
Extremely beautiful; amazing to look at
Sweet and pretty, like a puppy
Covered with soft hair
Soft and nice to hug

entries.example: A baby bear is called a 'cub'.

entries.description: So sweet that you just love it

entries.description: To say that you are not happy about something

entries.description: The outline of something, e.g. round or square
